ctx-c05.output: With six wallets backing them, their family must be loaded.

ctx-c05.reflect: "6个钱包" refers to the six wallets of two parents and four grandparents pooling money to support one child—a Chinese internet term for family financial backing. "家里有矿" is slang meaning the family is super rich. Literal "have a mine" would confuse English viewers, so use an idiom like "loaded" or "made of money."
